δόλῳ: δόλος — trick, guile, cunning; masc. dat. sg.: ’by a trick’

δώσω: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)

εἴπῃσιν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (ν-movable, = Attic εἴπῃ): ’may say’
εὔχεσθαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. inf. mid./dep. · also εὔχομαι — declare, boast; pres. inf. mid./dep., as an imperative, with indirect statement: ’declare’ (εὔχεσθαι ἐμὲ νικῆσαι ’declare that you beat me’)
ζυγόν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., object of δέω: ’a yoke’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of κρίκε: ’the yoke’ (κρίκε δὲ ζυγόν ’and the yoke creaked’) · also neut. acc. sg., with the compound verb ὕπαγε: ’under the yoke’ (ὕπαγε ζυγόν ’led under the yoke’)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
θέοντος: θέω — run; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with τοῦ: ’as he ran’
θείομεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic (= Attic θῶμεν): ’let us put’
θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’) · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (θυμὸν ἐχώσατο ’was angered in heart’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θόρε: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔθορε): ’leapt’
θώρηκα: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακα)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’) · also κ’ + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὁπποῖόν κ’ εἴπῃσθα ’whatever sort you say’) · also κ’ + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will, in that case’ (οἵ κ’ … κείσοντ’ ’who will lie’) · also ὄφρά κ’ + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κ’ ἔτι γνῶμεν ’so that we may learn’)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’) · also + short-vowel subj. in a main clause: ’shall’ (ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι ἰδέω χάριν ’I shall acknowledge the favour’) · also + pres. indic. in a main clause, generic: ’would’ (καί κέ τις εὔχεται ’any man would pray’) · also εἴ κέ + long-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἴ κέ μ’ … συλήσωσι ’if … should strip me’) · also with a relative + subj. in a general clause: ’whoever’ (ὅς κέ … ἔλθῃ ’whoever comes’) · also ἐπεί κέ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’once, when’ (ἐπεί κέ τις … ἕληται ’once someone takes’)
κέλευθον: κέλευθος — way, path, course; fem. acc. sg. (pl. also neut. κέλευθα)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν τις … βάλῃ ’whenever someone hits’) · also ἤ κέν + subj. κίχανεν: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκίχανεν), ν-movable: ’came upon, found’
καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
καλλίτριχες: καλλίθριξ — fair-maned (καλός + θρίξ ’hair’, stem καλλιτριχ-); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’
κασσιτέροιο: κασσίτερος — tin; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the material
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also ὄφρά κε + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κε … ἔλθῃσι ’until … comes’) · also + aor. subj. in a main clause, potential: ’might, would’ (τώ κε κορεσσάμεθα ’then we might have our fill’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg. act.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’) · also ἠέ κεν + aor. inf., a potential alternative: ’or to perish’ (ἠέ κεν … ὀλέσθαι) · also ὁπποτέρῳ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’to which of the two … may’ · also ἐπεί κεν + aor. subj., in a temporal clause: ’once’ (ἐπεί κ’ ἀπὸ τεύχεα δύω ’once I put off my armour’) · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κεν εὕρῃ ’until he finds’) · also εἴ κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’whether’
κεχολωμένος: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’angered’

κονίῃ: κονίη — dust; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic κονίᾳ)
κρείσσων: κρατύς — strong; comparative κρείσσων, stronger, mightier (= Attic κρείττων); masc. nom. sg.
κρητῶν: Κρῆτες — the Cretans; masc. gen. pl.
λάβ: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented and elided (λάβ’ = λάβε, Attic ἔλαβε): ’took’
λέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. pass. 3 sg., with simple past force: ’had been left behind, was left behind’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.

μέλλεις: μέλλω — be about to, be bound to, be sure to; pres. 2 sg. (+ inf.)

μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’

μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc. dat. sg. used as a noun: ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle, in the midst’ · also adj. agreeing with a noun: ’in the middle of’ (μέσῳ ἐνὶ ὁμίλῳ ’in the midst of the throng’)

μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
μεσσηγὺς: μεσσηγύς — between, in the midst; adv./prep. + gen.: ’between’
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας

μηριόνης: Μηριόνης — Meriones, Idomeneus’ Cretan comrade; masc. nom. sg.

μώνυχες: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed (with an undivided hoof); adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι

νέστορος: Νέστωρ — Nestor, old king of Pylos; masc. gen. sg.
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
νηλήϊος: Νηλήϊος — of Neleus, Neleian; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Nestor, son of Neleus
νυν: νυν — now, then; enclitic particle (= νῦν)
νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἰσέμεναι: φέρω (fut. οἴσω) — bring, carry; fut. inf. act. in -έμεναι (= Attic οἴσειν): ’to bring’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)

οἴκοθεν: οἴκοθεν — from home, from one’s own house; adv., -θεν suffix ’from’
οἴχεται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. with perf. sense, 3 sg.: ’is gone’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. · also + gen.: ’in front of’
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its noun: ’around’ (πόλιν πέρι ’around the city’)

παρέλασσ: παρελαύνω — drive past, outstrip; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, epic -σσ- (= Attic παρήλασε), elided (παρέλασσ’ = παρέλασσε): ’drove past’
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the plain’ (ἐκ πεδίοιο)
πεπυκασμένα: πυκάζω — cover thickly, wrap; perf. part. pass., neut. nom. pl.: ’covered over’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

πετέσθην: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented: ’the two flew’
πηλεΐδην: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles · also Ποδάρκης — Podarces, son of Iphiclus, leader of the men of Phylace; masc. nom. sg., proper name
πολέος: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πολλοῦ)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
πολὺς: πολύς — much, many, great; masc. nom. sg., grave accent mid-clause (πολὺς ὀρυμαγδός ’a great din’)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’) · also prep. + gen., ’toward’ (ποτὶ πτόλιος ’toward the city’)
ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; masc. acc. sg., interrogative: ’what sort of (word)?’
πρήσσοντε: πρήσσω (= Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, make one’s way; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual, Ionic -ησσ-: ’the two making (their way)’
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; comp. adv. προτέρω: ’farther on’
πρόβατ: πρόβατον — sheep, flock animal (what walks forward); neut. nom. pl., elided (πρόβατ’ = πρόβατα)
πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’ · also adv., elided: ’in front, before him’
πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα): ἔπεα πτερόεντα ’winged words’

πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν): ’gave’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σθένελος: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Capaneus; masc. nom. sg.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
στέρνοιο: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)

τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
ταχέ: ταχύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. dual, elided (ταχέ’ = ταχέε): ’two swift’
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσσω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic τελέσω), after ὄφρα: ’until I accomplish’

τιταινόμενος: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; mid. strain oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’)

τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τοῦτο ἔπος ’this word’)
τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod (three-footed cauldron, a prize); masc. gen. sg., after περί: ’for a tripod’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the tripod’
τρίχες: θρίξ — hair; fem. nom. pl. (stem τριχ-)
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’) · also neut. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸ μὲν … τὸ δέ: ’one thing … another’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’so great’ (τόσσον μένος)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.

τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · ὁ, ἡ, τό — relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which, that’ (τὰ … πεφύκει ’that had grown’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’

τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)

φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.

φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); masc. nom. sg.

χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.

ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. sg.
ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’ · also dual, of two things: ’both (hands)’

ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject of ἧντ’: ’leaders (were sitting)’
ἡνίοχον: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. acc. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’ · also ’beat out, hammer (metal)’: aor. 3 sg., ’hammered’
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came, passed’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδομενεῦ: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. voc. sg.
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἱμάσθλην: ἱμάσθλη — whip, lash; fem. acc. sg.
ἴφθιμος: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵπποις: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., object of ἕπομαι (+ dat.): ’horses’ · also masc. dat. pl., of accompaniment: ’with the horses’ (ἵπποις ἀΐσσων ’darting with the horses’) · also masc. dat. pl., after κέκλοντο: ’called to the horses’ · also dat. pl., indirect object: ’into the horses’ (ἵπποις ἧκε μένος ’put might into the horses’)
ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’ · also acc. sg., of a single horse in apposition to a name: ’the horse’ (Πήδασον … ἵππον ’Pedasus the horse’) · also acc. sg., fem.: ’a mare’
ἵππω: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. dual: ’two horses’ · also masc. nom. dual: ’the two horses’ (ἵππω πλήξαντε ’the two horses, striking’)
ὀϊλῆος: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
ὄχεσφι: ὄχος — chariot, car; neut. instrumental case in -φι (= dat. pl. ὄχεσι): ’with chariots’ · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (παρ’ ὄχεσφι) · also with ὑπό, locatival: ’under the chariot’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφι ’beneath the chariot’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ … ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’stirred up’)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκυπόδεσσιν: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ὠκύποσι), agreeing with ἵπποισιν
ὠτώεντα: ὠτόεις — eared, with ear-shaped handles; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic lengthened ὠτώεντα (= ὠτόεντα), agreeing with τρίποδα
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ᾤκτειρε: οἰκτείρω — pity; aor. 3 sg., augmented (οι- → ῳ-): ’pitied’
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥαθάμιγγες: ῥάθαμιγξ — drop, splash; fem. nom. pl.
